proposed_capability: P95/P124: recognize native Enter center-active-Sim vs Shift+Enter center-lot, map a non-native app-specific opt-in camera-follow hotkey, and provide a code follow-Sim route through an injected game-runtime adapter. Reuse ui_chrome hotkey owner, camera_traverse controls, and cooperative queue; never invent a native follow shortcut, capture global keystrokes, move cursor, or override player camera ownership.
player_save_control_impact: Opt-in one-shot camera focus request only; read-only plan by default, no save writes or auto follow every frame; never consume keyboard input globally. Center route uses existing shared Win32 send_key_chord under independent 15-second idle/session/game Live-mode admission; follow uses optional game-runtime API adapter and trusted exact SimInfo, not mouse simulation or a fabricated native hotkey.
expected_outcome: The host can plan center(active Sim) with Enter, center(lot) with Shift+Enter, and follow(active Sim) via game API or an app-defined scoped hotkey event. Target identity, active scene, capture freshness, operator presence and input focus are checked before effect. Unknown game API or human interruption is review/deferral, not mouse fallback.
negative_tests: No claim that Enter creates continuous follow
No native follow shortcut invented; app-defined binding is opt-in and not OS-global
Missing Live-mode or Sim identity blocks follow and center
Stale capture or active Sim changes reject dispatch
Cooperative queue idle, cross-agent locking and interruption remain effective
Code adapter missing S4CL fails closed without input
One action only; no unattended polling or auto-reclick
rollback_path: Revert PR; no Sims saves, installed mods, global keybindings, local account settings or active sessions mutated.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build game-host keyboard handling and S4CL camera-follow integration require P08 local in-game proof; code-level callback success alone is not game camera follow observation.
App-specific hotkey needs an opt-in local key-event source within a future installed module; this change does not install a global keyhook.
